metadata.setting: small rural town with park, pool, soccer field, farmer market, school, farm, library, and hospital

characters.name: Marcus Chen
characters.background: Second-generation Chinese-American who became mayor after his father's hardware store went bankrupt. Married to Diane in a loveless marriage and having an affair with Patricia. Craves power and respect above all else.

relationships.relationship_summary: Loveless marriage of convenience, knows she married him for stability not love

Bitter enemy over land development deal, sees him as obstacle to progress
Jealous of his natural command of respect
Tension over Emma's education and Dorothy's criticism of his priorities

characters.name: Robert Hawkins
characters.background: Fourth-generation farmer recently widowed, raising son Jake alone. In bitter feud with Mayor Marcus over land development that would destroy part of his family farm. Struggles with grief expressed as anger.

relationships.relationship_summary: Strained relationship with son who wants to leave the farm, feels betrayed

Old friend who supports him against Marcus

characters.name: Miguel Rodriguez
characters.background: Mexican immigrant who came at age 15, works loyally for Robert. Secretly in love with Sofia who is dating Kevin. Wants to bring his younger sister from Mexico and achieve stability.
personality_traits: core_motivation: achieve stability and family reunification

characters.name: Helen Park
characters.background: Korean-American nurse who was best friends with Robert's late wife. Developed unrequited feelings for Robert after caring for his wife during her illness. Struggles with loneliness and feeling she missed her chance at love.

characters.name: Dorothy Washington
characters.background: First in her family to attend college, has been educator for 35 years. Estranged from adult daughter who blames Dorothy for being a better principal than mother. Channels maternal instincts into students.
personality_traits: core_motivation: leave legacy of educational excellence

characters.background: Young progressive teacher who believes in emotional intelligence. Dating soccer coach Luis but wants marriage while he focuses on career. Feels undermined by Principal Dorothy and dealing with student Jake's inappropriate crush.
personality_traits: core_motivation: make genuine difference in young lives

characters.background: Married Marcus for financial stability not love, now trapped in loveless marriage. Distant relationship with daughter Emma. Suspects husband's affair but too proud and afraid to leave.
personality_traits: core_motivation: maintain security and social status
